capabilities: Import Xiaohongshu notes from pasted share links, singly or in batches
Download note images into the vault for offline reading
Write configurable frontmatter fields using placeholders
Skip duplicate imports by matching note IDs against a persistent index
Record publish date, author info, and like/save/comment/share counts
extras: The manifest carries the note "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." The README includes a network-usage disclosure (requests only go to xiaohongshu.com and its CDN, no login or telemetry) and a scope section listing limitations such as no comment import, no profile scraping, and dependence on the site's current page structure. Beta updates are available via BRAT.
intentEvidence: the direct upstream this plugin derives from
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture Xiaohongshu note content, images, tags, and metrics as local Markdown without logging in.

relations.evidence: the direct upstream this plugin derives from
the original plugin that upstream was adapted from

summary: Imports Xiaohongshu notes into the vault as Markdown with configurable frontmatter, locally downloaded images, and engagement metrics.
